title: Stable Emerald Ore and No Monster Stone MC
description: This Mod For World Generation Removing Infested Stone and Changing Emerald Ore
body:
A pretty simple and small mod that changes the generation of Emerald ore rarely in any biome and disables the generation of Infested Stone from world generation.


If you want to make sure that emerald ore generates exactly the same way like other gems in the **Mine Tools and Blocks MC** mod, then this mod is for you.

This mod is very suitable for Modpacks if you want to find emeralds in any biome.

Also suitable if you don't want to run into silverfish while mining.

**Warning**: This mod does not use procedures and adding new blocks, the only thing it includes is 1 custom element
